summary: Corteza is a self-hosted customer relationship management platform that combines a unified workspace, enterprise messaging, and a low-code environment. It allows organisations to rapidly build and deploy secure, records-based management applications on their own infrastructure. Built using the Go programming language, it provides an open-source alternative for teams requiring centralised business tooling.
goodFor: It is well-suited for technical teams and enterprises looking to build custom, records-based CRM solutions while keeping full control over their data and workflows.
watchOut: Deploying and maintaining a comprehensive low-code platform with integrated messaging requires significant administrative overhead compared to simpler single-purpose CRMs.
deployNotes: As a Go application, it typically compiles into a single binary, but you will usually need to provision a separate relational database, configure persistent storage, and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
